check-s0i3.title: OpenBook power check: S0i3 (about 3 min, then powers off)
check-s0i3.options: printk.devkmsg=on audit=1 panic=-1 8250.nr_uarts=1 binder.impl=rust cma=0 firmware_class.path=/vendor/etc/ loop.max_part=7 bootconfig console=ttyS0,115200 loglevel=7 log_buf_len=8M rdinit=/openbook-check/probe openbook.probe=report openbook.probe.sleep=1 openbook.probe.dgpu=detach openbook.probe.acpi_d3cold=_SB.PCI0.GPP0.SWUS openbook.probe.s0i3_snapshot=1 openbook.probe.s0i3_steps=psp,dummy,asus

check-s0i3-long.title: OpenBook power check: S0i3, 60 s cycles, all steps
check-s0i3-long.options: printk.devkmsg=on audit=1 panic=-1 8250.nr_uarts=1 binder.impl=rust cma=0 firmware_class.path=/vendor/etc/ loop.max_part=7 bootconfig console=ttyS0,115200 loglevel=7 log_buf_len=8M rdinit=/openbook-check/probe openbook.probe=report openbook.probe.sleep=1 openbook.probe.dgpu=detach openbook.probe.acpi_d3cold=_SB.PCI0.GPP0.SWUS openbook.probe.s0i3_snapshot=1 openbook.probe.sleep_s=60 openbook.probe.s0i3_steps=psp,dummy,asus openbook.probe.s0i3_all=1

check-hw.title: OpenBook hardware check (no sleep test)
check-hw.options: printk.devkmsg=on audit=1 panic=-1 8250.nr_uarts=1 binder.impl=rust cma=0 firmware_class.path=/vendor/etc/ loop.max_part=7 bootconfig console=ttyS0,115200 loglevel=7 log_buf_len=8M rdinit=/openbook-check/probe openbook.probe=report
